- Cu+2 → [Cu(NH3)4]+2 (deep blue)
- Zn+2 → [Zn(NH3)4]+2 (colorless)
- Cd+2 → [Cd(NH3)4]+2 (colorless)
- Ag+ → [Ag(NH3)2]+ (colorless)

- With NH3: Co(OH)2 (blue) and Cd(OH)2 (white) precipitate initially; Cd(OH)2 dissolves in excess NH3 forming [Cd(NH3)4]+2
